name: io.github.tonyyang0504/bonanza-mcp
description: Bonanza (ecommerce channels): me, create_listing, end_listing, list_orders, mark_shipped. Every tool

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BONANZA_DEV_ID
environmentVariables.description: Developer id (dev_id) of your approved Bonanza API account (api.bonanza.com > Apply for an API account); sent as the X-BONANZLE-API-DEV-NAME header.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BONANZA_CERT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Certificate id (cert_id) of the same API account; sent as the X-BONANZLE-API-CERT-NAME header.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BONANZA_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The seller's verified user token (fetchToken, then the seller approves it at the returned authentication URL); sent in every request body as requesterCredentials.bonanzleAuthToken. Tokens expire a year after issue or when the seller deactivates them.
